blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Known failure modes, engineered out at the architecture level:

items: Alert flood
Alerts deduplicated and correlated before they reach a human — the pages that remain are pages worth answering.
Flat-network habits
Segmentation applied where flat networks used to be — lateral movement dies on a denied connection.
Audit theater
Controls tested where the work happens, with evidence generated as a by-product — the audit becomes a walkthrough, not a reconstruction.
